name: QZmini @ Artillery Sidewinder X2 4.0 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; =====================================================================
; QZmini cold-extrusion start G-code (Quasizero Slicer) - Marlin family
; STATUS: PROVISIONAL - offline validated only, NOT hardware validated
; =====================================================================
G90 ; absolute XYZ coordinates
M83 ; relative E (QZmini plunger drive)
M302 S0 ; allow cold extrusion at any temperature (syringe drive, no hotend use)
M220 S100 ; reset speed factor
M221 S100 ; reset extrusion rate factor
; No nozzle heating, no bed heating, no thermal waits: QZmini prints cold.
G28 ; home all axes (preserved from original machine behaviour)
; NOTE: automatic bed leveling (G29) intentionally omitted. Probe clearance with
; the QZmini syringe assembly is UNVERIFIED. Re-enable only after physical check.
G1 Z10 F600 ; safe Z lift
G1 X10 Y10 F3000 ; smooth travel to start corner
G92 E0 ; reset logical E
machine_end_gcode:
; QZmini cold end G-code (Quasizero Slicer) - Marlin family
M400
G92 E0
{if max_layer_z + 40 < printable_height}G1 Z{max_layer_z + 40} F600{else}G1 Z{printable_height} F600{endif}
G1 X0 F3000 ; park the head at the left edge - drips land off the piece
M106 S0
M84
machine_pause_gcode: M0 ; pause, wait for user (Marlin; resume validation pending on hardware)
